snippet.title: Godot Horror Game | Abyss Chamber - Steam Open Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4377360/Abyss_Chamber

Steam open playtest will start on March 30th, 2026. Feel welcome to join! "Abyss Chamber" is a 3D horror game on Godot Game Engine, and currently it's in the polishing phase, so if you want to participate, just wishlist it on Steam and join the open playtest soon.
